title: Nonce-keyed state/event procedure execution
priority: Supersedes obsolete indexed-iterator and renderer handoff mechanics only; all unrelated AGENTS.json instructions and full state/schema requirements continue to apply.

persistent_record.inputs: All accepted prior input values keyed by semantic keyword
persistent_record.completionReceipt: The saved completion response containing the completion indicator, configured message, nonce, and all accepted inputs keyed by semantic keyword

reference.preservation: Existing complete instructions, compact projections, full return schemas, schema_derivation rules, read_keywords, diagnostics, and semantic validators must not be shortened or discarded.

events.nonce: Fetch the saved record. Return the completion receipt for a completed record. Otherwise render its stored state.projection without recalculation.
events.nonce(input): Fetch the saved record. Return the completion receipt for a completed record without processing the submitted input. Otherwise validate input using stored state.projection.final_schema and state-specific substantive validator. On rejection save diagnostic on current projection and re-render. On acceptance save value in inputs[state.keyword]; generate next state using state.next, resolving read_keywords against inputs and deriving final_schema; save the new record under the same nonce before rendering. At null next, mark complete, generate and save the completion receipt with the final accepted input, and return the receipt. For an older completed record without a saved receipt, derive it from the saved accepted inputs.

generation.schema_derivation: The state's derive_schema binding identifies the function called at projection construction, never on replay or after render.
generation.render: Output-only; must not collect the next input or produce a separate issuedSchema.
